subsystems.name: Model architecture
subsystems.role: the neural network that turns text into predictions.

subsystems.name: Training infrastructure
subsystems.role: the compute cluster that trains the model.

subsystems.name: Data pipeline
subsystems.role: collects and prepares the text the model learns from.

subsystems.name: Training algorithm
subsystems.role: the optimization methods that adjust the model's weights.

subsystems.name: Alignment system
subsystems.role: fine-tunes the model to follow instructions safely.

subsystems.name: Inference engine
subsystems.role: serves the model to users efficiently.

buildSteps.title: Design the architecture
buildSteps.detail: Choose the transformer variant, such as a mixture-of-experts, and set layer counts, hidden sizes, and attention type.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the training cluster
buildSteps.detail: Procure thousands of GPUs, connect them with high-bandwidth networking, and install distributed training frameworks.

buildSteps.title: Collect and clean data
buildSteps.detail: Crawl and filter a large text corpus, remove duplicates, and tokenize it into a training format.

buildSteps.title: Pre-train the model
buildSteps.detail: Run unsupervised training to predict the next token, using parallelism to spread the work across many GPUs.

buildSteps.title: Fine-tune on instructions
buildSteps.detail: Train on curated question-answer pairs so the model follows user commands.

buildSteps.title: Align with human feedback
buildSteps.detail: Use reinforcement learning from human feedback to improve helpfulness and safety.

buildSteps.title: Evaluate and red-team
buildSteps.detail: Benchmark on language tasks and test for harmful outputs, then iterate.

buildSteps.title: Deploy for inference
buildSteps.detail: Quantize and optimize the model for fast serving, and expose it via an API.
